title: Catholic school, Jones school, Straight University and self-education
summary: Albert lists his schools, says he left college studies to play music, claims a high school degree, and says he educated himself through contacts and reading.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Oh, I went to school. I attended Catholic school when I was at Bar at St. Francis is on Bill and Maroney. And of course I used to go to Maroney school. It was a block around there just to be with the kids and the teachers seemed to like me and I could go into rooms. and then after I left Catholic school I went to Jones school which is on Annette and Galvest but there was also a part of the school we used to call it Bucket of Blood. It was an old long house with a bunch of rooms in it. And I don't know why they gave the name of Bucket Blood but that's what we went for our first second and third grade and then when we launched the school we went to Jones school I was transferred from Birold school to Joseph A.
